narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The lowest common multiple is the two numbers multiplied, so it is two thousand nine hundred and forty!
<bookmark mark='twice'/>But the two and the seven are counted twice in that multiplying.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A number that counts shared primes twice is too big to be the lowest.
